quests.name: Coldtooth Supplies
quests.text: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Horde Quatermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Coldtooth Supplies
quests.text: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

quests.name: Irondeep Supplies
quests.text: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Horde Quartermaster in Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
quests.text: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.  Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

quests.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
quests.text: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.  Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

quests.name: Empty Stables
quests.text: Locate a Frostwolf in Alterac Valley. Use the Frostwolf Muzzle when you are near the Frostwolf to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Frostwolf will follow you back to the Frostwolf Stable Master. Speak with the Frostwolf Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

quests.name: Empty Stables
quests.text: Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

quests.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
quests.text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
quests.text: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Towers and Bunkers
quests.text: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Towers and Bunkers
quests.text: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Quartermaster
quests.text: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

quests.name: Capture a Mine
quests.text: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
quests.text: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

quests.name: Capture a Mine
quests.text: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Battle of Alterac
quests.text: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Battle for Alterac
quests.text: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Proving Grounds
quests.text: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

quests.name: Proving Grounds
quests.text: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Legend of Korrak
quests.text: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.  Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.

quests.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
quests.text: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.  Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
quests.text: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.

quests.name: Speak with Voggah Deathgrip
quests.text: Speak with Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Armor Scraps
quests.text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

quests.name: Enemy Booty
quests.text: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

quests.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
quests.text: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

quests.name: The Sovereign Imperative
quests.text: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.  For the glory of Bronzebeard!

quests.name: Brotherly Love
quests.text: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

quests.name: Brotherly Love
quests.text: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

quests.name: Fallen Sky Lords
quests.text: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

quests.name: Fallen Sky Lords
quests.text: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

quests.name: Favor Amongst the Darkspear
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at Frostwolf Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.

quests.name: Ally of the Tauren
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.

quests.name: The Human Condition
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and Frostwolf keep) with a Human Bone Chip.  A cure for the human condition is close at hand!

quests.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.

quests.name: Staghelm's Requiem
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with Darkspear Troll Mojo.

quests.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.

quests.name: Defusing the Threat
quests.text: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

quests.name: Defusing the Threat
quests.text: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Frostwolf Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

quests.name: The Return of Korrak
quests.text: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.  Return the Skull of Korrak to Warmaster Laggrond in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Korrak the Everliving
quests.text: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.  Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Wanted: DWARVES!
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.  Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.

quests.name: Wanted: ORCS!
quests.text: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.  Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

quests.name: Invaders of Alterac Valley
quests.text: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

quests.name: Remember Alterac Valley!
quests.text: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

quests.name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips
